validity.recommendation: merge into P3381 or re-scope as the rebuilt DN 500 stretches of the same line; keep one row per physical corridor
validity.researcher_notes: This row has the same name as P3381 and no source describes a second line. The operator's 2021 notices describe one Shebelinka to Sloviansk pipeline being replaced section by section with DN 500 pipe, with four sections done and a fifth, 13.5 km, planned. This row (500 mm, 54 km, built 2020) most likely records the rebuilt sections of the same corridor that P3381 records as the old 700 mm pipe. The 54 km, 2020 and 2022 values have no source; only the 500 mm diameter is confirmed. A person should rule on the merge.

Searched the 2021 operator notices and Wikipedia. They say four sections were rebuilt in earlier years and the fifth was planned in 2021, but give no construction year for the 500 mm sections. The sheet's 2020 is not supported or contradicted.

No source found with an in-service year for the rebuilt 500 mm sections. The 2021 notices say the fifth section was still planned, and Wikipedia mentions a 2015 tender for the 67 km job. The sheet's 2022 is not supported.
Searched Ukrainian-language operator notices and Wikipedia. No design capacity found, only a 1.0 million cubic meters a day consumption figure.

The notices give the whole rebuild span as 67 km (km 1.1 to 68.0) and the fifth section as 13.5 km. If the first four sections are about 53.5 km, that would match 54 km, but no source states the 54 km figure, so it is not staged as supported. Sources: the two operator notices.
